title: CircleSfera Dependency Security Exceptions
description: Schema for approved temporary dependency vulnerability exceptions in CircleSfera.

package.description: Name of the vulnerable dependency package.

advisoryId.description: Security advisory identifier, GHSA ID, or CVE identifier.

reason.description: Technical justification for why the exception is required.

mitigation.description: Compensating runtime architectural controls preventing exploitation.

expiresAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when this exception automatically expires (max 30 days).

approvedBy.description: Name or handle of security engineering owner approving this exception.
